visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses wears a black collared shirt, standing against a nighttime backdrop of the Taipei 101 skyscraper. He speaks animatedly with frequent hand gestures and changing facial expressions. (2) A white rectangular graphic overlay appears, showing a close-up image of a translucent blue-tinted contact lens resting on the tip of a person's index finger. (3) A scientific diagram of a human eye is displayed, illustrating light rays entering the lens with labels for different wavelengths including 980 nm, 808 nm, and 1532 nm, showing how infrared light is converted. (4) The scene returns to the man in the black shirt, who continues his explanation with a neutral yet focused expression against the urban night background. (5) A brief scene from a classic movie is shown, featuring actors at a gambling table; one man is holding up a contact lens while others watch in a dimly lit, high-stakes environment. (6) The man returns to the frame, maintaining his previous position and attire, using his hands to emphasize points about the technology's application for color blindness. (7) A highly detailed 3D graphic shows a cross-section of a human eye with a contact lens being applied; technical grid patterns and text overlays suggest a medical or high-tech context. (8) The final shot returns to the man, who smiles slightly and holds up a small, green glowing object between his thumb and index finger before the video concludes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 閉眼仍可見！新隱眼解鎖紅外視力. [Subtitle]: 當眼睛很酸很想睡覺. (2) [Subtitle]: 但又有事情必須處理怎麼辦. (3) [Subtitle]: 告訴各位一個好消息. (4) [Subtitle]: 中國科學技術大學的科學家. (5) [Subtitle]: 發明了一種隱形眼鏡. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓你閉上眼還能繼續工作. (7) [Subtitle]: 法克. (8) [Subtitle]: 他們把一種叫做上轉換奈米顆粒 (upconversion nanoparticles UCNPs) 的黑科技塞進了我們平常戴的軟式隱形眼鏡裡. (9) [Subtitle]: 它能吸收我們肉眼看不見波長大約在 800 到 1600 奈米之間的近紅外光. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後變成我們能看見的可見光. (11) [Subtitle]: 欸沒錯是變成人眼可以感知到的波長. (12) [Subtitle]: 但不是像我們之前提到的創造新顏色. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以波長 980 奈米 的紅外線在你眼中可能變成藍色光. (14) [Subtitle]: 808 奈米的變成綠色. (15) [Subtitle]: 1532 奈米變成紅光等等. (16) [Subtitle]: 而且閉上眼睛看效果更好. (17) [Subtitle]: 因為我們的眼皮能更有效地阻擋可見光的干擾. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以近紅外光的訊號就能更清楚地穿透進來. (19) [Subtitle]: 研究者表示這個技術可以幫助色盲朋友看到通常看不見的東西. (20) [Subtitle]: 嗯我知道你在想什麼. (21) [Subtitle]: 這副最新隱形眼鏡不用 11 萬美金. (22) [Subtitle]: 預估成本只要 200 美元. (23) [Subtitle]: 欸記得到了公海再用. (24) [Subtitle]: 而且這種奈米黑科技也不是沒有代價的. (25) [Subtitle]: 有些上轉換奈米顆粒表面包裹了某些聚合物. (26) [Subtitle]: 例如聚乙烯亞胺 PEI 可能會對細胞產生毒性. (27) [Subtitle]: 除此之外奈米顆粒非常靠近視網膜. (28) [Subtitle]: 轉換出來的光線容易散射. (29) [Subtitle]: 所以影像解析度還得再打折扣. (30) [Subtitle]: 但不論如何如果有贏記得.
